# Get all albums from library (paginate)
access_token = login_result['access_token']
all_albums = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    albums_page = apis.spotify.show_album_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not albums_page:
        break
    all_albums.extend(albums_page)
    if len(albums_page) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1
print(f"Total albums: {len(all_albums)}")
print(all_albums)

# Compute total downloaded duration per album
from collections import defaultdict

album_downloaded_duration = defaultdict(int)
for song in downloaded_songs:
    album_downloaded_duration[song['album_id']] += song['duration']

# Check which albums have total downloaded duration >= 1200 seconds
qualifying_albums = []
for album in all_albums:
    total = album_downloaded_duration.get(album['album_id'], 0)
    if total >= 1200:
        qualifying_albums.append((album['album_id'], album['title'], total))
        print(f"Album {album['title']} (id={album['album_id']}) has {total}s downloaded")

if not qualifying_albums:
    print("No album qualifies")
else:
    # Pick the first one
    chosen = qualifying_albums[0]
    print(f"Chosen album: {chosen}")
